name: fuzz-setup-so-retrieve-rediscard
description: Fuzz pbd289 / pbd297 (stall:waiting-on-me-long in playerSetup, secretObjectivesToDiscard 1, 6 min): a player discarded a dealt secret objective, then pressed 'Retrieve <secret>' (drawSpecificSO_, ui.undo_affordance). The secret came back, so setup waits on a discard again, but the discard prompt they answered was gone and nothing new was offered. Fix (bot fuzz-triage-1): SecretObjectiveButtonHandler.drawSpecificSO re-offers the discard buttons while setup still needs a discard.
